191661.overview: Saga no Gabai Baachan DS is an Action game, developed by Beyond Interactive and published by Tryfirst, which was released in Japan in 2009.

191662.overview: Saitou Takashi no DS de Yomu Sansyoku Ballpen Meisaku Jyuku (齋藤孝のDSで読む三色ボールペン名作塾) is an educational game for the Nintendo DS published by Sega in Japan.

191663.overview: Shikakui Atama o Maruku Suru. DS: Joushiki, Nanmon no Shou is an edutainment video game released for the Nintendo DS in Japan on 28 September 2006. Developed and published by IE Institute, the title is part of a larger franchise focused on brain-training and educational drills.

191664.overview: Shikakui Atama o Maruku Suru. DS: Kanji no Shou is an educational video game released for the Nintendo DS in Japan on September 28, 2006. Developed and published by IE Institute, the title translates to "Make your square head round: The Kanji Chapter" and is part of a larger series of brain-training and educational software.

191666.overview: Shikakui Atama o Maruku Suru. DS: Keisan no Shou is an educational video game released for the Nintendo DS that focuses on mathematics and mental calculation. Developed and published by IE Institute, it was originally released in Japan on 28 September 2006.

191667.overview: Hisui no Shizuku: Hiiro no Kakera 2 DS(翡翠の雫　緋色の欠片2 DS) is an otome game created by Idea Factory. It is the second installment of Hiiro no Kakera series of video games. It tell the adventure of Takachiho Suzu who was summoned back to her village when Mao, her sister figure, disappeared, to succeed the role of Tamayorihime, the miko who'd sacrifice herself to keep the land safe from the wrath of the sea lord.

191698.overview:
Sanrio is a Japanese company known for creating and marketing a wide range of characters, with Hello Kitty being its most famous. "Style Book: Cinnamoroll" is about another character of theirs, Cinnamoroll. The game functions as an electronic diary where players can schedule events, set alarms, and collect "Smile Points." These points can be used to obtain various items such as colored pencils and stickers to personalize the diary entries.

Players can use the software to manage their daily schedules, with features allowing them to set reminders and alarms. As they interact with the game, they gather "Smile Points," which can be exchanged for decorative items to customize their virtual diary. The interface encourages creativity and organization, making it both a practical tool and a playful experience for fans of Cinnamoroll and Sanrio characters.

191700.overview:
"Style Book: Fushigi Boshi no Futago Hime Gyu!" is a part of the Style Book series by Bandai. This game centers around the characters from the anime "Fushigi Boshi no Futago Hime," also known as "Twin Princesses of the Wonder Planet." The game functions primarily as an electronic organizer and diary, allowing users to manage their schedules and set reminders.

Players can use this software to organize their daily activities, set alarms, and keep track of appointments. The game also includes features that allow players to earn points and unlock various customization options, such as decorative stickers and colored pencils, to personalize their digital diaries.

191703.overview: Sugar Sugar Rune: Queen Shiken wa Dai-panic is based on the Sugar Sugar Rune anime and manga series. Players follow the characters Chocolat and Vanilla as they compete to become the next Queen of the Magical World. The game involves collecting hearts by attracting boys and gathering their heart vibes via a number of action-oriented minigames.

191706.overview: Suisui Physical Assessment Training DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Medika Shuppan, which was released in Japan in 2011.

191707.overview:
Suite PreCure: Melody Collection is a rhythm-based game set in the Suite PreCure anime universe. Players take on the roles of characters from the series, participating in musical mini-games that involve timing-based button presses. The game features various songs from the anime, with players required to hit notes in sync with the music to achieve high scores.

The gameplay consists of multiple stages, each with its own song and difficulty level. Players can choose their favorite characters and unlock new content as they progress through the game. The objective is to complete songs with the highest accuracy possible, earning points and unlocking additional tracks and costumes for the characters.

191763.overview: Saku-Saku Jinko Kokyu Care Training DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Medika Shuppan, which was released in Japan in 2010.

191764.overview:
Sangokushi Taisen DS (三国志大戦DS) is a strategy game for the Nintendo DS. It was based on the 2.0 version of the arcade game.

For whatever reason, the B (for 12 and up) rating in the side of the box have a cyan background instead of the green one (like most of B rated Japanese games).

191765.overview: Sangokushi Taisen Ten (三国志大戦天) is a strategy game for the Nintendo DS. It was based on the 3.0 version of the arcade game.

191766.overview: Sansuu Puzzle de Migaku: Gakken Otona no Shikou Sense is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Gakken, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191767.overview: San Goku Shi DS 2 is a Strategy game, developed and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 2007

191769.overview: San-X Chara Sagashi Land is an Action game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2007.

191770.overview: San-X Land: Theme Park de Asobou is an Action game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2006.

191771.overview: Shion no Ou: The Flowers of Hard Blood is an Adventure game, developed by NCS and published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191772.overview: Shoho Kara Hajimeru Otona no Eitango Renshuu is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Now Production, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191773.overview: Shoukou Shindan Training DS (often referred to in English databases as Shoko Shindan Training) is a medical educational game for the Nintendo DS, developed and published by Medika Shuppan. Released exclusively in Japan in 2011, it is designed to help users, particularly those in the medical field or nursing students, train their diagnostic and clinical observation skills.

191875.overview:
Shugo Chara! Amu's Rainbow-Colored Chara Change is a Shugo Chara! video game for the Nintendo DS. It was released in Japan on November 6, 2008.

The Guardians plan on holding a "Best Friends Contest" at their school. For the next three months, Amu juggles studying for tests and training for matches while finding a person to attend the contest with by hanging out with them afterschool and on days off. The aim of the contest is to think about the people who are important to them.

Amu can Character Change with Guardian Characters who are not her own, being able to Change with Yoru, Daichi, Temari, Il and El.

191876.overview: Get ready for some Easter fun with Amu and her guardian fairies (shugo chara). Amu appears cool and aloof, but in reality, she is really just clumsy with words and too shy to express herself. Her greatest wish is to change herself and her awkwardness. Her wish is answered one night in the form of three eggs that appears on her bed. They hatch to reveal three fairies Ran, Sue and Miki. Together with them, Amu joins the guardian team to defeat the dark forces that plagued her home town. And in her spare time, she trains to become more skillful in areas such as sports, cooking and school work with her sprites. And her ultimate aim is to win the heart of the man she likes.

191895.overview: Puzzle Series Vol. 9: Sudoku 2 Deluxe is a Puzzle game, developed by AI and published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 2006.

191919.overview: "Shinri Kenkyuuka Yuki Yu Kanshuu: Mainichi Kokorobics: DS Therapy" is a Japanese Nintendo DS game (NTR-AYUJ) designed as a daily mental health "therapy" tool, supervised by researcher Yuki Yu. It acts as a mental wellness program, likely incorporating daily exercises or check-ins to improve "kokoro" (mind/heart) health.

191921.overview: Shin Noukyo Iku is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Marvelous Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2009.

191949.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 1 - The Mahjong is a board/card game developed by Warashi and published by D3Publisher. It is part of the Simple DS Series franchise.

191950.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 5: The Trump (or THE Trump Simple DS Series Vol. 5) is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS game released in 2006, featuring seventeen different classic card games like Solitaire, Poker, and Othello, developed by Vanguard Works, IGN for D3 Publisher, as part of their budget-friendly "Simple DS Series". It offered single-player and local multiplayer (including Download Play) and was a collection of digital card/board games, not related to Donald Trump.

191954.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 8: The Kanshikikan: Kinkyuu Shutsudou! Jiken Genba o Touch Seyo! (often shortened to The Kanshikikan) is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS adventure/visual novel game released in 2006 by D3Publisher, focusing on detective work where players investigate crime scenes using the DS touch screen, featuring multiple cases and an unlockable final file.

191955.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 9: Atama ga Yoku Naru - The Me no Training (meaning "To Make Your Head Better - Eye Training") is a 2006 Japanese Nintendo DS game from D3Publisher, developed by Japan Art Media, focusing on educational brain training and eye exercises for 1-4 players, known for being part of D3Publisher's budget-friendly Simple DS line.

191956.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 10: The Dokodemo Kanji Quiz (or The Everywhere Kanji Quiz) is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS game released in 2006 by D3Publisher, focusing on learning Japanese kanji characters through various quizzes, part of D3's budget-friendly Simple DS Series

191957.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 11: Mou Ichido Kayoeru: The Otona no Shougakkou is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS game from 2006 by D3Publisher, part of their budget-friendly series, offering adults a chance to revisit elementary school subjects like math, science, and Japanese through quizzes and mini-games with cartoon teachers, requiring Japanese language skills to play.

191958.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 12: The Party Unou Quiz (or The Party Right Brain Quiz) is a Japanese brain-training puzzle game for the Nintendo DS, released in late 2006 by D3Publisher, featuring various logic and right-brain exercises like counting dice or finding shapes, supporting up to four players wirelessly for party fun.

191960.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 14: The Jidousha Kyoushuujo (or THE 自動車教習所 DS) is a Japanese Nintendo DS game about driving school, released in 2007 by D3 Publisher for the NTSC-J (Japan) region, offering realistic driving simulation on the handheld console. It's part of the budget-friendly Simple DS Series and focuses on driving practice and license acquisition, a popular concept in Japan, featuring typical driving test scenarios for the DS platform.

191961.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 15: The Kanshikikan 2: Aratanaru Yattsu no Jiken o Touch Seyo (The Police Investigator 2: Touch 8 New Cases) is a Japanese adventure game for the Nintendo DS, released by D3 Publisher in 2007, focusing on detective work and solving crimes in the Simple DS Series budget line, known for its straightforward gameplay.

191962.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 16: The Sagasou Fushigi na Konchuu no Mori (Let's Find the Mysterious Forest of Insects) is a Japanese Nintendo DS action RPG where you play as a hunter's son, catching escaped insects in a magical forest, featuring monster-collecting mechanics similar to Monster Hunter and a hunger bar, released around June 2007 in Japan. It's part of D3 Publisher's budget "Simple Series" and offers 243 insect types to collect.

191963.overview: Pilot a fully customizable mech suit in this side scrolling action game. You can swap parts and add upgrades to make your mech suit unique to you! This game features random level generation and a branching story that makes for tons of replay value! You'll never play through the same game twice! There is also a multiplayer versus mode in which up to 4 players can connect wirelessly and battle it out using just one cartridge! This game is a must own for any fans of the Mobile Suit Gundam series or any other mech related games or anime.

191964.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 19: Yareba Dekiru!: The Micro Step Gijutsu de Oboeru Eitango is a Japanese Nintendo DS edutainment game from the budget-friendly Simple DS series, focusing on learning English vocabulary using "micro-step techniques," released by D3Publisher in 2007, designed to help users master English words through small, manageable steps.

191965.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 20: THE Senkan (known as THE Battleship) is a maritime naval combat game released for the Nintendo DS in August 2007. Developed by Tamsoft and published by D3 Publisher, it is part of the budget-priced "Simple DS" series of Japanese games. 

The title is a mix of action, simulation, and strategy where players control a battleship in various combat missions. Unlike traditional board games like Battleship, this title features active naval warfare where players must maneuver and fire on enemy fleets.

191966.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 21: The Hohei: Butai de Shutsugeki! Senjou no Inu-tachi (also known as The Infantry) is a tactical third-person shooter developed by Tamsoft and published by D3 Publisher. Released in Japan on 30 August 2007, it is part of the budget-friendly "Simple" series and is a handheld follow-up to the PlayStation 2 title Simple 2000 Series Vol. 102: The Hohei: Senjou no Inu Tachi.

191967.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 22: Age Age The Zero-Yon Midnight (also known as The Zero-Yon Shinya) is a budget racing game for the Nintendo DS, released exclusively in Japan on 20 September 2007. Published by D3 Publisher and developed by Tamsoft, it focuses on "Zero-Yon" (400-meter) drag racing with a unique anime-style presentation.

The game follows the protagonist, Ryoji, as he competes to become the fastest drag racer while interacting with a cast of 10 female rivals.

191970.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 24: The Sensha (translated as The Tank) is a tank simulation and action game released for the Nintendo DS as part of D3Publisher's budget "Simple" series.

The game focuses on straightforward tank combat where players navigate 3D environments to destroy enemy forces.

191971.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 25: The Koushounin (also known as The Negotiator) is a Japanese text-based adventure and simulation game released for the Nintendo DS. Developed by Affect and published by D3 Publisher, the game originally launched in Japan on 25 October 2007.

191972.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 26: The Quiz 30,000 Mon is a Japanese trivia game released for the Nintendo DS on 20 December 2007. Developed by Luxe and published by D3 Publisher, it is part of the budget-friendly "Simple DS Series" franchise.

191975.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 27: The Misshitsu kara no Dasshutsu ~The Suiri Bangai Hen~ is an escape-the-room adventure game for the Nintendo DS. Released exclusively in Japan on 29 November 2007, it was developed by Intense and published by D3 Publisher as part of their budget-friendly "Simple" series.

 Players must solve various puzzles and find hidden items to escape from locked environments. It serves as a side story ("Bangai Hen") related to the broader Misshitsu kara no Dasshutsu (Escape Trick) franchise.

191976.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 28: The Illust Puzzle & Suuji Puzzle 2 is a puzzle collection released for the Nintendo DS in Japan on 29 November 2007. Developed by Digital Ware and published by D3 Publisher, it is the 28th entry in the budget-friendly "Simple DS" series.

191977.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 30: THE Table Game is a compilation of classic board and card games developed and published by D3 Publisher for the Nintendo DS. It was released in Japan on 20 December 2007.

191978.overview: The Zombie Crisis is a horror themed light gun shooter, developed by DreamFactory and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2008.

191979.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 33: The Crossword & Kanji Puzzle is a puzzle game released for the Nintendo DS in Japan on March 13, 2008. Developed by DigitalWare and published by D3Publisher, it is part of the long-running "Simple DS" franchise known for offering budget-friendly, focused gameplay experiences.

191980.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 34: The Haisha-San (THE 歯医者さん, literally "The Dentist") is a dental simulation game released for the Nintendo DS as part of D3 Publisher's budget "Simple DS" series.

191981.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 35: The Genshijin DS (SIMPLE DSシリーズ Vol.35 THE 原始人) is an action-strategy game released for the Nintendo DS. It is part of D3 Publisher's "Simple Series," which focuses on budget-friendly titles with straightforward gameplay concepts.

191982.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 36: ALC de Mi ni Tsuku! TOEIC Test: Bunpou Tokkun Hen is an educational Nintendo DS title released exclusively in Japan. It was developed by Vingt-et-un Systems and published by D3Publisher.

 The title focuses on grammar training (Bunpou Tokkun) for the TOEIC test, using materials from the Japanese educational publisher ALC.

191986.overview:
In order to fight fires in the wild, a fireman needs an axe, a hose, and fire retardant robes. In order to fight fires on the Nintendo DS, all you need is a touchpen. Join a crew of fire fighters who venture bravely into infernos in order to rescue innocents and control raging fires. To shoot water at flames, simply tap on the target with the touchpen to drench and extinguish it. To break down doors and other obstacles, the axe may be used as a sort of battering ram.
In addition to normal flames, end level "boss" flames which are tougher to beat must also be contended with. The top screen shows an overhead map of the stage while all of the action takes place on the touch screen. Over 30 missions are featured in the game for DS firefighters to conquer.

191990.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 43: The Host Shiyouze! DX Knight King is an adventure dating simulation game released for the Nintendo DS in Japan on 12 March 2009. Part of D3 Publisher's "Simple" budget line, it was developed by Avantec.

In this title, you play as a male host whose goal is to climb the ranks of the nightlife industry. The primary gameplay loop involves: 
Luring Customers: You must flatter and lure women into your bar to increase revenue.
Mini-games: Gameplay includes various mini-games focused on activities like dancing and drinking.
Customisation: You can earn money to buy new clothing for your character to improve your appeal as a host.
Interaction: The game features touch-controlled interactions and requires navigating social scenarios typical of the Japanese host club scene.

191992.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 44: The Gal Mahjong (also known as THE ギャル麻雀) is a traditional mahjong game for the Nintendo DS, released exclusively in Japan on 25 September 2008. Developed by Affect and published by D3 Publisher, it is part of the long-running "Simple" series known for budget-friendly, focused gameplay.

191993.overview:
Simple DS Series Vol. 45: The Misshitsu kara no Dasshutsu 2 (translated as The Escape from the Sealed Room 2) is a first-person adventure and puzzle game released for the Nintendo DS on 27 November 2008. It is part of D3 Publisher's budget "Simple Series" and specifically belongs to the Escape Trick franchise.

As an escape-the-room title, the game tasks players with navigating various locked environments. Gameplay typically involves: 
Investigation: Searching rooms in a first-person perspective to find hidden items or clues.
Puzzle Solving: Using collected objects and environmental hints to unlock doors and progress through stages.
Stylus Interaction: Utilizing the DS touch screen to examine objects and interact with the environment.

191994.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 46: The Hikyou Tankentai: Choujou Special (full title: Kyoui! Jinrui Mitou no Sekai Kakuchi ni Nazo no Mikakunin Seibutsu wa Sonzai Shita!!) is an action-adventure survival game released for the Nintendo DS on 19 February 2009. Published by D3 Publisher and developed by Japan Art Media (JAM), it follows an expedition team searching for "Unidentified Mysterious Creatures" (UMAs) like Bigfoot in extreme environments.

191996.overview: Simple DS Series Vol. 48: The Saibanin: 1-tsu no Shinjitsu, 6-tsu no Kotae is a Japanese adventure visual novel developed by WitchCraft and published by D3 Publisher for the Nintendo DS. Released on 21 May 2009, the game puts players in the role of a lay judge (saiban-in) tasked with uncovering the truth through courtroom battles.

192088.overview: Sankei Sports Kanshuu: Wi-Fi Baken Yosou Ryoku Training: Umania 2007 Nendo-ban is a Sports game, developed and published by Dimple Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2007.

192092.overview: Sansuu Olympic Iinkai Kouan: Suuji de Kitaeru Nouryoku Training: Algo & Trinca is a Nintendo DS educational puzzle game released in Japan on May 24, 2007, authorized by the Math Olympic Committee. It features, as the title suggests, training exercises focused on numerical skills, specifically "Algo" (Algorithm) and "Trinca" puzzles to boost brainpower and mathematical ability.

192093.overview: San-X Character Channel: All-Star Daishuugou! is an Action game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2008.

192312.overview: In this DS adaptation of the television series Samantha Oops !, the player embodies Samantha and must triumph over 16 unlikely situations in order to have a hell of a day.

192313.overview: Welcome to the house of secrets. Secret Story on DS is a simulation game based on the TV show of the same name. Take on the eight-week challenge as one of twelve mysterious characters, each hiding a secret. It's up to you to discover secrets among fifty different ones. Increase your popularity and collect cash before the long-awaited final. But remember to pay attention to the voice. That's all for the moment.

192894.overview: The Celestini are the reigning champions, but the qualification for the next world championships is still in the balance, especially after the departure of the Finezza twins. Fortunately, two new players have taken their place, their names are Jeremy and Samira. If they want to defend the title, the Celestines will have to start training again and show everyone that solidarity, friendship and respect are the foundations of Street Football. Take part in the adventures of the second season, with 7 new minigames and 2 new characters. As in the television series, each character has their own particular playing techniques. Travel the world and face opponents of all nationalities.

199422.overview:
Mehr Kreuzworträtsel Ensure fresh head nuts: Over 1100 new crossword puzzles are waiting to be solved by them.

Special puzzles from different areas of knowledge will help you to train your knowledge.The different levels of difficulty ensure smoking gray cells in beginners and advanced.

More crossword - new puzzle fun for young and old now on your Nintendo DS!

Features:
* Handwriting recognition, intuitive operation for Nintendo DS newbies
* 5 Different areas of knowledge with knowledge progress check
* Over 1110 crossword puzzles in German
* High quality puzzles created by SZ experts
* Simple operation also for Nintendo DS newbies.

199508.overview: In Spooky Story the player steps into the role of Arty. In the middle of the night, far away of any civilization, Arty needs to find a way back home and unfortunately he ends up in a very strange haunted house. Luckily, Arti's not afraid that easily...

203526.overview: Thanks to Larousse Buddy Spanish on DS, you will become a crack in Spanish. This edutainment title aims to clearly explain grammar rules, as well as a range of vocabulary classified by theme. Spanish-speaking dictations and lots of fun mini-games are also on the program.

206473.overview:
Spirits DS is a remake for the Nintendo DS game based on the popular TOPO SOFT SPIRITS which in 1987 performed the corresponding versions for computers 8-bit MSX, Spectrum and Amstrad.

The project's goal is to make a remake to keep the spirit of the original, but adapted to the possibilities of the Nintendo console. It includes two versions, original graphics, drawn directly from the MSX version and an enhanced version, with graphics by graphic designers from the NightFox team.

It is presented in the NEO Retro Coding Compo 2012.  [gamebrew.org]

208844.overview: Aura-Aura Climber is an arcade-style game where you control a star which has fallen from the sky. Your goal is to grab onto grapple points floating in the air, which lift you higher and higher. By pressing the A Button to grab at the peak of the jump, you'll gain a bit of extra height. You can also use the Control Pad to change direction as you climb upwards, allowing you to reach out-of-reach grapple points. Finally, you can drop from great heights to your advantage, as grappling as you fall past a grapple point will slingshot you back in the opposite direction. By mastering all of these techniques, you can quickly and skillfully navigate to the goal at the top of the level.

208847.overview: Sudoku allows the player to play Sudoku on his console or handheld. Like in other Sudoku games the goal is to fill a 9 by 9 grid with the number one through nine. Each numbers has to be placed in the right spot on a grid, where each line and section can only contain each number only once.

209612.overview: Wicked ghosts have kidnapped the president’s daughter, trapping her in a haunted mansion! As a plucky young bird trooper you must use your bomb-throwing abilities to defeat the ghosts and rescue the girl. Ghosts can only be destroyed by throwing bombs into their mouths. Use the stylus to set your throwing angle and take your best shot! Bounce bombs off walls and eerie floating furniture to defeat all the spooks in each stage, but make sure not to run out of bombs or you're in for a fright! In addition to the main Story Mode, you can really put your skills to the test in Challenge Mode with only a limited number of bombs to last you through to the end. But never fear; with perseverance and accuracy, you're sure to replenish your supply and stay in high spirits!

210080.overview: Drill till you drop with the latest version of Mr. Driller exclusively for the Nintendo DSi!  Featuring the classic addictive gameplay that the series is known for, Drill Till You Drop has three different game modes and over 40 stages of non-stop drilling action!  Go underground with Mission mode and dig in various locales with deeper and more challenging goals, race against the clock to reach the goal in Time Attack mode or drill through a labyrinth of stones to collect the rare and precious Dristones in the Nintendo DSi-exclusive Dristone mode. Choose one of the six different drillers, drill through a seemingly endless onslaught of coloured blocks, avoid falling obstacles, and strategically manage your oxygen on the go!

210115.overview: Save the Turtles takes players to 32 of the world’s most exotic beaches in a quest to help tiny turtles find their way to the sea. Players must use the stylus to rub and tap the Touch Screen on the Nintendo DSi, digging eggs from the sand and lining-up cute reptiles while avoiding crabs, seagulls and litter on their way to the safety of the sea.The game features four game modes, including a survival mode called “Turtles Forever”, and several unlockable trophies. Give Mother Nature a hand and help Save the Turtles!

210116.overview:
Command your fleet to victory in this epic battle on the open seas!

Hidden in the untamed ocean lies an enemy ready to attack. Launch strikes and counter-strikes with missiles and powerful torpedoes to locate and submerge your enemy’s entire fleet in this new rendition of the classic paper-and-pencil game, Battleship.

Use additional content such as scanners to gain intelligence and detect the location of your enemy. Challenge your friends to battles against your fleet to see who really rules the seas with local wireless play. You can also tackle missions and battles on your own in three different single-player modes. Your only hope of survival is to uncover your enemy’s whereabouts before they uncover yours!

210117.overview: You are a down and out big-time boss in the small time since your company was forced into bankruptcy by an underhanded competitor - one that stooped lower than even you would dare.Of course, revenge is a dish best served over a drink at the high class gentlemen's club. This is where the game will take place to rebuild your fortune and show your competitor who really is boss.This is a witty card game with a few simple rules to test your intelligence.

210119.overview: Simply Mahjong gives you exactly what you want: pure Mahjong on your Nintendo DSi! The simple game design and easy, intuitive controls make it a game that the whole family can enjoy. The game has 50 puzzles in each level to guarantee hours of gameplay fun.

210120.overview: Simply Minesweeper gives you exactly what you want: pure minesweeper on your Nintendo DSi! The simple game design and easy, intuitive controls make it a game that the whole family can enjoy. The game has 50 puzzles in each level to guarantee hours of fun gameplay.

210121.overview: Simply Solitaire gives you exactly what you want: pure Solitaire on your Nintendo DSi! The simple game design and easy, intuitive controls make it a game that the whole family can enjoy. The game has 50 puzzles in each level to guarantee hours of gameplay fun.

210122.overview: Simply Sudoku gives you exactly what you want: pure Sudoku on your Nintendo DSi! The simple game design and easy, intuitive controls make it a game that the whole family can enjoy. The game has 50 puzzles in each level to guarantee hours of gameplay fun.

210123.overview:
The game is an unique blend of the „Snake“ and „Arkanoid“ game concepts. Using the stylus the player controls a snake on the lower screen and tries to use it to bounce the ball destroying boulders on the upper screen. In each level the boulders are organized in a different shape.

At the same time the snake has to avoid enemies and may collect bonuses, falling out of the destroyed boulders. The aim of the game is to finish all the levels with the most points.

210124.overview:
Snowboard Xtreme offers a race against the clock through stages filled with dangers – you'll need a lot of skill, because time isn't on your side! Try to take full advantage of the terrain, earning extra time by passing through the flags correctly.

Beat your friends and family on the local ranking and reach number one. Do not hesitate to take control of Dundee the Mad Crocodile. Good luck!

210125.overview: The game is a variation on a warehouse keeper theme. There are several crates placed on the playing area. The player controls a figure that can push the crates forward. The aim is to get all the crates on the places designated.

210126.overview:
The work of a warehouse keeper has never been so tough! Will you earn the Cool Job?

Sokomania 2 enhances the popular gameplay principles with many new dynamic features. The traditional maze full of crates that have to be pushed to the right spots is just an opening warm-up in Sokomania 2. Everything changes the instant momentum comes into play; crates start to move on their own, corridors become divided with doors, and switches or turntables that can change the direction in which crates move appear on the floor. At moments like these, one has to start thinking hard or patiently experiment with various possibilities.

210127.overview: Spin Six is a puzzle game guaranteed to bring a new twist to the genre. It’s all about rotating number panels to make horizontal or vertical lines of the same number to clear them from the board. While that sounds simple, the challenge lies in your ability to make chains of number panels to score even bigger points. There are four unique game modes, each with various skill levels. Puzzle mode brings you nearly 200 puzzles, split into One-Turn or Chain categories, or you can challenge your panel elimination skills in Time Attack mode. Pit yourself against a time limit in Score Attack mode (use the Spinnerator to get into Fever Time and really boost your score!), while Chain Challenge is about making as many chains as you can in one go. With easy to master, but deep gameplay, it’s about time you gave Spin Six a whirl!

210129.overview:
SteamWorld: Tower Defense is a simple tower defense game and the first entry in what would become the SteamWorld series. The player places auto-attacking robotic units along paths across fourteen different levels to try and stop shambling humans from entering the robot gold mines and cities. If five humans get past all of the player's units and to the end of the path, the player loses the level.

In the game the player has five types of units they can place: 1. Gunslingers: Basic towers. Cheap and weak. 2. Repeaters: Shoots many weaker shots quickly and has high health but costs more. 3. Bomber: Shoots bombs that do damage in an area of effect, but will also damage the player's own units. Heals itself automatically. 4. Sharpshooter: Extremely high damage, but will only shoot manually where the player taps and then requires a cooldown after. 5. Bartender: Very high health and does no damage but slows down enemies.

210133.overview: In Successfully Learning Mathematics Year 3, pupils will solve exciting maths problems with the little vampire Freddy to learn maths in a playful way. Freddy motivates the children and helps with tips. All problems are based on the current curriculum for maths.

210135.overview: Sudoku 4Pockets offers you 3600 puzzles and Kiku your assistant will be there to guide you through each of the Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced Skill levels.The aim of Sudoku is to complete a grid of 9 x 9 squares with the numbers 1-9 in each square, row and column.As you play Kiku will guide you, she can tell you if you have entered an incorrect number, offer you hints and explain the moves and terms as you play.The simple to use number entry makes it easy to select numbers and add possible number candidates to aid your thought process.Whether you are new to Sudoku or an advanced player you can have fun playing and learning on your quest to be a Sudoku Master.

210136.overview:
Sudoku Student packs 50 entry-level puzzles to solve. Puzzles designed by Nikoli, the Sudoku experts.

Sudoku Student brings you the first Nintendo DSiWare Sudoku experience with all the features you'd expect! For "students" of Sudoku who are just getting their feet wet, Sudoku Student comes with a full tutorial. Once you’ve completed the tutorial, jump into simple and easy-going Sudoku puzzles. Designed for entry to beginner level players, you’ll find just the right amount of challenge to keep you hooked!

210137.overview:
SUDOKU SENSEI packs a super-hard 100 challenging puzzles to solve. Puzzles designed by Nikoli. Includes tutorial!

Introducing 100 "Super Hard Puzzles" for the hardened sudoku veteran! All puzzles are skillfully designed for a level of satisfaction that computer-generated puzzles just can't offer. You can play through puzzles to learn about rules and controls in "Tutorials" mode! Other handy features include "Write Mode" and "Temp Number" for an easier, more enjoyable sudoku experience.

210138.overview:
From Japan comes a new kind of board game that combines puzzle and strategy in a battle of wits. Take turns against human or computer opponents to reach a target score, by placing numbered tiles on the board.

Score points by linking the arms of each tile in various ways: tiles with the same number or sequence of numbers, and tiles in a loop. Also look out for special squares that affect play in new ways, and useful items that aid you in your pursuit of points.

Go it alone in the main Story or Puzzle modes, or battle against up to three opponents across the world via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. You can even learn from your past with History mode, showing the moves recorded during previous Nintendo WFC contests.

210139.overview: Can't get enough of swapping puzzle games, but want something different? Swap 'til you drop with Super Swap!, an exciting blend of arcade action and match-3 fun. Drag colourful blocks in one of four directions to connect three or more blocks and clear the board. As new blocks fall, you'll have to move fast to keep the stack from reaching the top! Experience plenty of twists and never-before-seen gameplay as you make combos, collect special power-ups and gain additional points in four different game modes. With so much fast and furious puzzling fun, you'll never want to stop the swapping!

210141.overview: Super Yum Yum Puzzle Adventures is a multi-award winning puzzle game featuring a chameleon called Leon. Featuring forty eight levels, across four worlds and exclusive Nintendo DSi features, players will navigate through many hours of mindbending gameplay while they try and rescue Leon's babies from the belly of Ms. Tum Tum! There are four worlds and 48 individual levels - there are also four mini-games in total, one in each world. The game stars Leon the Chamelon who must eat his way through fruity, fiendish puzzles, licking fruit to change colour and choosing the right combinations of fruit to finish each level.

210142.overview: Surfacer+ is easy to pick up and has totally innovative gameplay. You’ll be surprised! Suitable for all gamers – occasional and hardcore alike.Fill the screen by producing white flowers with your stylus. Control the size of your flowers and use the bonuses at the right moment. Watch out for enemies who pounce from either side of the screen.

210143.overview:
Welcome to Centerscore High, where each choice you make changes your game! But remember, some choices are wiser than others…

Play the premiere “Football Season” storyline plus 7 episodes for hours of gameplay. You cause all the drama!

Master addictive mini-games and ace pop quizzes along the way.

210197.overview:
Shoot blocks from your UFO to place them in the right spots and complete a wide variety of picture puzzles! 

Welcome to Snapdots! Complete dozens of puzzle pictures by rotating the puzzle to find the best angle and then shooting blocks from your UFO. If the placement isn’t quite right, use the UFO to grab blocks back to shoot them in different spots. Adding to the challenge, puzzles often contain several types of blocks and spots, each with its own characteristics, on the playing grid. Journey to multiple planets to tackle puzzles individually in Puzzle mode or try to clear as many puzzles as you can within the time limit in frenetic Time Attack mode. In either mode, the combination of strategy and action result in a classic puzzle game that definitely hits the right spot!

213178.overview:
"Sarainneun Yeongeoro Ganghaejineun Siljeon!: DS Yeongeo Sammaegyeong" is the South Korean title for the Nintendo DS edutainment game known internationally as Practise English!. 
The game is part of the "English Training" franchise and was designed to help users improve their English language skills through interactive exercises.

213180.overview: Learn and train chess in a playful way! The game is clearly structured in: rules/practice, tactics/strategy, training and competition. All areas are accessible from the start. Thus, the game is also suitable for players with previous knowledge. If you already know the rules, you can start training right away, deal with tactics or fight against the "opponent". The story: Giselmund, the chess-mad ghost was robbed by pirates! Ironically, they swiped his favorite chess game! Drago, the fierce pirate, is only willing to give up his chess pieces if he is beaten in a chess game on his pirate ship... - Clearly structured game structure - Fast successes - Motivating story - Multiplayer mode possible

213194.overview:
The full title in English translation appears to be "Shichidasik Unoedallyeon: Super Brain DS" or "Shichidasik Unoedallyeon - Super Brain". The original Japanese title is likely 七田式右脳鍛錬すぱトレ (Shichida-shiki Unō Tanren Supatore).

 The game is designed around the Shichida method, a renowned educational approach developed by Makoto Shichida, which focuses on training and stimulating the right hemisphere of the brain through various exercises. These exercises typically involve elements like speed reading, memory games, and image recognition, aimed at enhancing creativity, intuition, and memory capabilities.

213195.overview: Spiegel Online Wissenstrainer is a quiz game. Answer more than 1000 questions on sports, politics and culture by selecting the right one from a couple of options. Answering correctly moves you up in ranks and gets you medals.

213196.overview: With the "SPIEGEL ONLINE – Career Coach" in your pocket, both young professionals and seasoned managers can playfully climb the next rung of the career ladder. Whether alone or in entertaining multiplayer mode with friends - this unique digital business guide trains the essential areas of professional life, such as the internet, etiquette, organization or business. In addition, practical career tips for all professional groups are provided. And if you complete a complete game round without making any mistakes, you can expect special rewards!

213197.overview: The SPIEGEL ONLINE knowledge trainer series The SPIEGEL ONLINE knowledge trainer series is the most comprehensive knowledge trainer series on the Nintendo DS to date. The top-class quartet covers popular topics such as general knowledge, careers, travel and self-management. Content from the extensive archive of SPIEGEL ONLINE, among other things, is conveyed in a playful way and the brain cells are encouraged to perform at their best. SPIEGEL ONLINE – Life Coach SPIEGEL ONLINE Life Coach declares war on stress and helps achieve the perfect balance between private life and work. Master everyday problems and start with new energy! With perfectly coordinated training programs from various subject areas such as beauty & care, etiquette, nutrition and leisure, this digital guide shows how to find the perfect work-life balance and master typical everyday problems in a playful way. And if you complete a complete game round without making any mistakes, you can expect special rewards! Beauty and grooming tasks are integrated as well as… …exercises for self-motivation and a healthy mind. With SPIEGEL ONLINE to a completely new attitude towards life! The level of difficulty of the tasks set is suitable for both beginners and advanced users. The design of the included exercises is tailored for accessibility, short game sessions - e.g. on the go - and quick game successes. In addition to solving the regular exercises, which constantly increase your awareness of life, the game offers you the opportunity, among other things, to practice all the types of questions and tasks it contains and to compare your own level of performance with the achievements of friends and family members

213198.overview:
With "Learning math while playing", children are playfully prepared for the requirements of pre-school and 1st grade. 18 mini-games introduce prospective school children to their first arithmetic tasks. They build on each other and are divided into the areas of writing and recognizing numbers, counting and arithmetic.
Writing and recognizing numbers: Practice writing and recognizing numbers
Counting: Matching a specific number of objects to the corresponding number
Arithmetic: First addition and subtraction in the number range from 0-9
Learning without reading: "Learn math while playing" does not require any written texts. All exercises can be completed easily and without reading skills. Each exercise is explained using a tutorial with music, so that no questions remain unanswered.

213199.overview:
Laura and the magical pony Startail have to face their first adventure on the Nintendo DS: A hiking trail is to be built right through the secret clearing and the secret of the unicorns is about to be discovered. The players slip into Laura's role and search for a way to prevent the construction of the hiking trail.

Take good care of Startail, because you can only protect the clearing with his magical powers. But Laura's friends and family also need your help.

The rousing adventure offers 15 quests, lots of exciting tasks, tricky riddles and tricky puzzles.


Features:
- Exciting adventure with 15 varied levels
- With many tricky riddles and puzzles
- Easy to use with intuitive point-and-click controls
- Recommended age: from 7 years
- Reading skills required

213200.overview:
The "Super Driving School" is a learning program for Nintendo DS with which the learner driver can prepare for the theoretical driving test at his own pace and thus maximize his chances of success. Whether in the bus or on the sofa, with the "Super Driving School" you can train anywhere .

Features:
* Official TÜV exam questions (status 12/2007)
* 12 driving license categories: A, A1, B, B1, C, C1, D, D1, L, M, T, MOFA
* More than 1,400 questions in 8 subject areas
* Practice mode and exam simulation under time pressure
* Mini-game "Labyrinth" in which traffic signs can be learned
* Extensive statistics functions with which the player can constantly check his progress.

213216.overview:
The all-inclusive package for globetrotters! SPIEGEL ONLINE - World Tour is the compact travel companion that combines all the important aspects of travel in a single fun package. SPIEGEL ONLINE – World Tour playfully conveys geographic and country-specific knowledge to all those who love to travel – from packing your suitcase to insider tips at the destination. And if you complete a complete game round without making any mistakes, you can expect special rewards!


Expand your knowledge of famous sights around the world, among other things.

Solve, among other things, geographic tasks about the most popular holiday destinations in the world.

Discover the whole world with SPIEGEL ONLINE!

The level of difficulty of the tasks set is suitable for both beginners and advanced users. The design of the included exercises is tailored for accessibility, short game sessions - e.g. on the go - and quick game successes. In addition to solving the regular exercises that you z. B. to constantly increase your country knowledge, the game offers u. the ability to practice all included question types and tasks at your leisure and compare your own performance level with the achievements of friends and family members. Are you ready for a trip into modern knowledge transfer?

Features:
Over 2000 questions from numerous topics: travel preparation, on the go, travel destinations, experiences, country & people, culinary, sights and nature & animals
Replaces bulky travel guides and fits in any trouser pocket
Varied question types and game modes (e.g. sorting questions, guessing questions)
Several game modes take you around the globe - from the Australian outback to New York
Open-world multiplayer for up to four players on one NDS
For travel professionals and short vacationers
Creation of own scores and profiles with personal avatars
Three levels of difficulty

213255.overview: Educational puzzles and fun with Sofie/Silke.

418171.overview:
Created by Wiseman, this software supports systems for nursing care and welfare facilities. It  was used by hospital staff to enter patients’ medical records into their database, which utilizes a communication middleware "VCE".

The software took advantage of the Nintendo DS's easy-to-use operability, information visibility on two screens, functionality, etc., making it much easier getting used to than using a computer to convert conventional care records into data, and inputting care information in the right place at the right time.

419938.overview:
A new way to play America's favorite puzzle pastime!

Sharpen your wits with authentic crosswords from the nation's No. 1 newspaper. Choose from hundreds of puzzles featuring handwriting recognition, a full keyboard, hints, a timer, and more. Test your skills in English and Spanish! USA TODAY Crosswords Challenge is the perfect game for puzzle fans!

440092.overview: Scrabble, one of the world's most popular board games, is enjoying a tremendous surge in popularity, both online and in the real world. Scrabble for the Nintendo DSiWare service allows you to play this exciting game in both Single Player and Multi-Player modes.

440094.overview: Scrabble, long considered to be one of the world's most popular board games, is enjoying a tremendous surge in popularity, both online and in the real world. Scrabble Slam! is a new way to play that challenges players to spell words as quickly as they can.

440095.overview: Sparkle Snapshots DS refers to a series of popular photo-taking and decorating applications for Nintendo handhelds, starting with Sparkle Snapshots for the Nintendo DSi (DSiWare) and followed by the enhanced sequel, Sparkle Snapshots 3D, for the Nintendo 3DS, offering features like custom backgrounds, stamps, frames, and even the ability to take selfies with the built-in cameras, similar to Japanese "purikura" photo booths.

440096.overview:
The award-winning Smart Girl's Playhouse series is back!

This time on Smart Girl's Playhouse Mini, little gamers will be delighted by the all-new graphics and games rebuilt from the ground up! Choose from 6 fun games and activities such as Drawing, Find Differences, Dress-Up and more! These wholesome games will bring out your child's talents and keep them occupied for hours. This title aims to give children and parents a great alternative to into the world of video games without inappropriate content.

440097.overview:
The game is an unique blend of classic game concepts. Using the stylus the player controls a snake on the lower screen and tries to use it to bounce the ball destroying boulders on the upper screen.

In each level the boulders are organized in a different shape.

At the same time the snake has to avoid enemies and may collect bonuses, falling out of the destroyed boulders. The aim of the game is to finish all the levels with the most points. The snake controlled by the player is composed of flexibly connected segments which bounce the ball.

Features

The game is an unique blend of classic game concepts.
Game modes: ARCADE, CHALLENGE, UNLIMITED
Game difficulty: EASY, NORMAL, HARD

440108.overview: Spaceball: Revolution will put your intelligence and skill to the test as you solve puzzles in a futuristic environment.You have to copy the figures that appear on the top screen, using energy balls to make the correct construction boxes change colour. But it won't be an easy task... different obstacles will be thrown in your path, forcing you to focus your aim and think rapidly. Fifteen different levels are waiting for you in "Spaceball: Revolution" - Are you up to the challenge? Only the very best players manage to reach the end!

440110.overview:
Shapo is a challenge that will keep you on the edge!

Shapo is a challenge that will keep you on the edge! Balance the scales as you place shapes made of different materials. Play more than 150 levels in Classic or Puzzle mode to unlock the greatest wonders of the world. Stunning art brings 15 wonders of the world to life! Enjoy exciting power ups such as the material bomb and line bomb. Each ball and shape has a different weight so be careful when placing your pieces!

*Classic Mode: Create lines to remove balls. Match sequential lines and watch the combo multiplier grow!

*Puzzle Mode: Complete increasingly complicated levels by filling the grid with the given balls.

440112.overview:
Hunt, battle and capture spirits in the real world, gaining experience to become a Professional Spirit Hunter.

Spirit Hunters Inc are overwhelmed!! They need YOU to join their ranks and become a Professional Spirit Hunter!

Using Augmented Reality, scan anywhere in the world to hunt, battle and capture as many of the unique spirits as possible.

With 96 Spirits, 16 Spirit families and 90+ abilities (each aligned to one of the 6 elements) there are plenty of opportunities to customize your experience as you increase your levels and ranks within Spirit Hunters Inc!

Watch out as there are rare Silver and Gold spirits to be found too. They are even harder to battle than their normal counterparts so you’d better build up your skills!

Spirit Hunters Inc: Light has 6 spirits which can only be obtained in this version. Use the Challenge system to exchange codes with your friends to unlock them all.

Features

* Utilize AR to scan, battle and capture spirits all over the world
* 96 Spirits, 90+ Abilities and Items, 100 levels and 10 ranks
*100s of hours of gameplay
* Unique challenge code system to swap battles with your friends

440116.overview:
With over 100,000,000 sudoku puzzles, you’ll never see the same puzzle twice in Sudoku Challenge!

Now’s your chance to play the brain-busting puzzle game taking the world by storm. With over 100,000,000 sudoku puzzles, you’ll never see the same puzzle twice in Sudoku Challenge! You can select the classic nine-by-nine sukodu gameboards as well as Grand Sudoku which challenges you to complete five intersecting sudoku boards simultaneously! Just a beginner? Don’t worry—with three difficulty options, even the most novice player can complete a sudoku with ease. But if you’re a seasoned pro, challenge yourself in ‘Hard’ mode and test your true skills. It’s time to get your thinking cap on and see how many sudoku puzzles you can conquer!

440118.overview:
In “Spot It! Mean Machines”, players race the clock to find the hidden objects in cleverly arranged scenes. The puzzles are based on the popular “Spot-It!” book series published by Capstone Press. See how many objects you can spot in 10 different puzzles. Vibrant graphics make spotting objects fun and challenging.

Players use the stylus to tap on the hidden objects and also to navigate the extra large play areas. Use the new “Zoom Out” feature to get a big picture of the puzzle.

Players can compete against their friends using the “Pass Around Play” feature. Up to four players can race to find 10 objects hidden within a puzzle. Each player has to spot the objects and then pass it on to the next player. See who can get the best score!

Find objects fast to score the most points. Three levels of difficulty (Easy, Medium, and Insane) provide unlimited replay value.

Based on the popular Capstone Press Spot It! Book Series, Combines Hidden Object fun with Puzzle scores, Vibrant and challenging images, Up to 4 players can play.

440120.overview:
Spot It! Challenge is a puzzle game built on hunting through photographic scenes to find hidden items. Think along the lines of Where's Waldo? This DSi Ware release is essentially the digital version of the Spot-It series of books from Capstone Press.

The game features ten different, carefully arranged photographic puzzles. Gameplay takes place on the bottom screen of the DS as players use the stylus to look for and tap the hidden items, as well as navigation of the image. Each of the ten puzzles is built around a different theme such as food, board games, sports, toys, etc. Standard gameplay has players racing against a clock. However, the game can be played by four players. In multiplayer--known as "Pass Around Play"--players take turns searching through a puzzle stage to see who can find ten items the fastest.

The game also features three difficulty levels--Easy, Medium, and Insane.

440122.overview: Slingo Supreme is the sequel to Slingo Deluxe, packed with even more Slingtastic fun. It features a new Supreme mode that lets you build more than 16,000 different Slingo games. It also offers an infinite supply of Daily Challenges, new Powerups (including Reel Nudge and Instant Slingos) and the long-awaited introduction of Devil Mini Games. Now you can finally take on that Devil and beat him at his own game.

440134.overview:
Hunt, battle and capture spirits in the real world, gaining experience to become a Professional Spirit Hunter.

Spirit Hunters Inc are overwhelmed!! They need YOU to join their ranks and become a Professional Spirit Hunter!

Using Augmented Reality, scan anywhere in the world to hunt, battle and capture as many of the unique spirits as possible.

With 96 Spirits, 16 Spirit families and 90+ abilities (each aligned to one of the 6 elements) there are plenty of opportunities to customize your experience as you increase your levels and ranks within Spirit Hunters Inc!

Watch out as there are rare Silver and Gold spirits to be found too. They are even harder to battle than their normal counterparts so you’d better build up your skills!

Spirit Hunters Inc: Shadow has 6 spirits which can only be obtained in this version. Use the Challenge system to exchange codes with your friends to unlock them all.

Features

* Utilize AR to scan, battle and capture spirits all over the world
* 96 Spirits, 90+ Abilities and Items, 100 levels and 10 ranks
*100s of hours of gameplay
* Unique challenge code system to swap battles with your friends

440136.overview: Scrabble, long one of the world’s most popular board games, is enjoying a tremendous surge in popularity, both online and in the real world. Scrabble Tools for the Nintendo DSi system helps players hone their skills by strengthening their vocabulary, pattern recognition and point strategies through fun interactive training exercises.

440244.overview:
This innovative, action shooter uses the Nintendo DSi Camera application to turn your surroundings into the playing environment! Truly unique and totally physical with 360 degrees of intensity, System Flaw Recruit is the future of handheld gaming excitement. You have been chosen to take part in the most arduous training program to combat the threat we call the Flaw. The invasion could take place at any time, so we need the best there is!

Innovative, action shooter uses the camera to turn your surroundings into the playing environment!

440287.overview:
Supermarket Mania, at its core, operates as a time management sim set in a grocery store. Or rather, five grocery stores. With a large 50-stage story mode, players take control of Nikki and must manage time and products to keep grocery stores stocked for customers. Besides just working to keep stores stocked, players have to deal with a competing grocery store. By working with speed and dedication, players earn enough cash to upgrade their grocery stores to better compete with the rival store.

Besides the large story mode, the game also features an alternate "Endless Shift" mode with bonuses, five total shops, and seven different types of customers. Supermarket Mania features over a dozen different products to manage, and over twenty upgrades for the stores.

Gameplay is seen and controlled on the bottom (touch) screen of the Nintendo DSi, and the game is viewed from an isometric angle similar to classic Sims games or old PC strategy titles. The top screen is largely used for statistics and other information.

443902.overview: Super Mario 64, the classic 3D platformer for the Nintendo 64, arrives on the Nintendo DS with all-new features that take advantage of the portable system's dual screens, touch screen, and wireless multiplayer capability. Like the original game, Super Mario 64 DS challenges you to find all the power stars hidden throughout the royal castle in the effort to free Peach imprisoned inside the castle. This time, you can play as Mario, Luigi, Wario, and Yoshi, each of whom has unique abilities. Overcome the challenges on your own or battle up to three of your friends in the multiplayer modes.

457232.overview: This is romhack have the same story of the original game but with shovel knight main character

460101.overview: This hack changes Julius Mode for Shadow Mode. In this mode, Julius is changed for Shadow the Hedgehog, Yoko for Sonic the Hedgehog and Alucard for Silver. All the skills and voices are changed. Sonic can transform into Super Sonic. The hearts were changed for rings and some texts was changed.

460109.overview: Knuckles, Amy and Tails must find Sonic in a rearranged and linear Dracula’s Castle before anything bad happens to him! Have them explore together and make good use of their unique powers in this Julius Mode hack.

462916.overview: Super Mario Bros. Galaxy DS is a homebrew fan game for the Nintendo DS by The Dark Master inspired by Super Mario Galaxy.

463170.overview: You may already know Strong Bad from his regular appearances answering emails and doling out not-so-useful advice on Homestarrunner.com. Now he's the star of a five episode comedy series, Strong Bad's Cool Game for Attractive People. With all new storylines co-written by the guys from Homestarrunner.com, you'll feel like you're inside Strong Bad's world. (You may even start to talk like him!) Each episode has a different theme and you get to hang out with with Homestar, The Cheat, Bubs the whole crew. It's like a Strong Bad cartoon on steroids.

463913.overview: This Super Mario 64 DS ROM hack places Waluigi over Yoshi, with his own new moveset.

465311.overview: Shichida Shiki Training Unou Tanren Unotan DS: Shun Kan Shoubu! Handanryoku is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS puzzle game focused on brain training and developing quick judgment skills, part of the "Shichida Style" method, released in Japan around 2005-2006 by Interchannel.

466735.overview:
Experience Mario like never before in New Super Mario Run DS, a one-world hack that reimagines the gameplay of New Super Mario Bros! This hack was inspired by the original Super Mario Run game and introduces a new automatic running feature in the New Super Mario Bros engine.

Features:
- Mario runs completely automatically
- New elements and tiles inspired by the original Super Mario Run game
- Completely new levels made for the auto-run feature
- Custom Bowser Jr. battles
- Custom UI
- Playable on emulator and real hardware!

468794.overview:
Super Among Us 64 DS is a ROM hack of Super Mario 64 DS.

Currently it is a single level demo with 7 collectable stars.

469320.overview:
This patch combines d0k3’s QoL improvements with Greiga Master/StraDaMa’s D-Pad Patch to address common frustrations in The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks, such as slow train travel and cumbersome mic-blowing. It enhances gameplay without changing the core experience.

Features:

* 1.5x faster train speeds in 2nd gear and reverse
* Boost mode (4x speed) by holding L or R, 8x speed with both L & R in 2nd gear
* Mic-blowing replaced by button input (L or R for flute, A everywhere else)
* Full D-Pad controls for movement, swordplay, and rolling
* A Super Secret Cheat Code for those who actually read readmes

472827.overview: Sudoku 150! For Challengers (Sudoku Master in US) offers 150 unique puzzles that beginners and experts alike will enjoy.

472838.overview: Sleep Clock: Record and Analyse Your Sleep Patterns (DSiWare Game) first released 29th Oct 2010, developed by Nintendo Software Technology and published by Nintendo.
